title: Translation
summary: Written text from one language into another, faithful and fluent, for a stated purpose and audience.
canDo: Documents, articles, web pages, product descriptions, emails, manuals, terms, UI strings
Keeping Markdown, lists, tables, links and code exactly as in the source
Using your glossary and leaving brand names and codes untranslated
Converting dates, numbers and units to the target conventions when you ask
cannotDo: Certified, sworn or notarised translations (no stamp, no legal liability)
Scanned images or PDFs: paste the text itself
More than 20,000 words in one job: split it into several jobs

fields.label: Text to translate
fields.help: Paste the full text. Only this text is translated.

fields.label: Who will read it, and where
fields.example: Vietnamese customers reading our online shop

fields.label: Glossary: terms that must be translated a set way
Keep exactly as written (brand names, product codes…)
Dates, numbers, units, currency
optionLabels: Convert to the target language's conventions

fields.label: Anything else the translator must know

acceptance: Complete: every sentence of the source is translated; nothing is left out and nothing is added.
Faithful: the meaning of each sentence matches the source; no meaning is changed.
Numbers, dates, amounts, links, code and placeholders are kept exactly, unless 'convert' was chosen for dates, numbers and units.
Every glossary term is translated as required, every time it appears.
Every item in 'Keep exactly as written' appears unchanged.
Fluent and natural in the target language for the stated audience, in the chosen tone, with terminology correct for the field.
Same structure as the source: paragraphs, headings, lists, tables and Markdown are kept.

deliverable.description: The translation only, in the target language, with the same structure as the source.
